title: Historic-replay baselining and PR gating for continuous perf regressions
creator: Ava Chen
description: Add a reproducible historic-replay based baseline and PR gating workflow in CI to catch token/sec and latency regressions before merges. The goal is to run a small, deterministic workload harness in the PR pipeline that replays sampled production traces (syntheticized to remove PII) against the candidate build and a pinned baseline build, compute throughput (tokens/sec), median and p95 latencies, and run paired statistical tests to detect regressions. This ticket covers: design of the baseline refresh cadence; selection of statistical tests and thresholds; minimum sample size for stable detection; failure policies (hard fail vs. warn-for-humans); hardware fingerprinting to avoid noisy false positives; integration with the PR gating mechanism; dashboards and artifact storage for post-mortem; and run-cost budgets per PR.
acceptance_criteria: CI job that runs replay harness on candidate build + pinned baseline and uploads summarized metrics
Paired statistical test implemented (bootstrap + permutation) with configurable alpha; default alpha=0.01
Gating rules: fail PR if median tokens/sec decreases >5% with p<0.01 OR p95 latency increases >10% with p<0.01
Minimum sample size enforced (N >= 30 runs) or job marks result unstable if below threshold
Baseline refreshable via weekly cron that records historical baselines and performs drift checks
Grafana dashboard exists showing recent PR comparisons, control charts, and per-model baselines
False-positive mitigation: hardware fingerprint check and run on pinned microbench cluster; CI will skip gating if cluster transient detected and surface a warning to the PR thread
comments: 2025-02-11 - Priya Nayar (PM): Please ensure we expose a clear override path for urgent security/bugfix PRs. We should allow manual bypass with audit logging.

2025-02-12 - Liam O'Connor (SRE): Hardware fingerprinting is critical — propose tagging runs with host kernel, CUDA, driver, and kernel build IDs. If these differ between candidate and baseline hosts, mark comparison as invalid.

2025-02-13 - Miguel Ortiz (assignee): Implemented initial harness prototype in CI runner with synthetic replay generator. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2567 — awaiting review for test matrix and secrets handling.

2025-02-15 - Ava Chen (creator): Decided on paired bootstrap + permutation test to reduce sensitivity to non-normal latency distributions. Trade-off: longer wall time for more resamples; we cap resamples at 2000 for PR runs and allow 10k for nightly regression jobs.
2025-02-16 - Priya Nayar (PM): Agreed on default gating thresholds but requested an experiment to validate thresholds against 90 days of production traces to estimate false positive rate.

2025-02-18 - Miguel Ortiz: Added unstable-run heuristic when CI variance > 12% across runs; job will rerun up to 2 additional times before marking unstable and leaving a human-review flag in the PR thread.
notes: Key design choices: 1) use paired comparisons to reduce cross-run variance impact; 2) keep the PR-level budget small (<= 60s wall time) by limiting sample count and resamples; 3) use weekly full baselines to detect drift and monthly long-run baselines for slower trends; 4) record raw traces and summary artifacts for post-failure triage. Follow-ups: add model-specific baseline profiles, evaluate alternative thresholds per model family, and implement a lightweight on-demand rerun API for engineering triage.
